content.short: Mint Club lets anyone create bonding-curve-backed tokens and NFTs using an existing ERC-20 as reserve.
content.description: Mint Club is a no-code creator for tokens and NFTs backed by bonding curves, using any ERC-20 as the reserve asset so a new token has liquidity from the moment it launches. A bonding curve sets price as a function of supply, which removes the need to seed a separate liquidity pool. It supports Unichain among the networks where tokens can be launched.
content.meta: Mint Club creates bonding-curve-backed tokens and NFTs with instant liquidity, including on Unichain.
